name: lem-compcb-compressed-unit-norm-CONTRACT
source: proofs/lem-compcb-compressed-unit-norm (af-validated 2026-07-24, 15/15 taint clean). FULL VALIDATED CONTRACT: Compressed-unit norm estimate: there are universal C_co < infinity and e_co > 0 such that, for e=delta+epsilon <= e_co, every delta-projection T satisfies ||u_T|| <= 1+C_co*e, and every nonvanishing T satisfies abs(||u_T||-1) <= C_co*e. (Here u_T = Co_T(T) is the compressed unit — NOTE the distinction from the column-Hilbert normalization factor wtQ = Co_Q(Q); at T=Q these coincide: u_Q = Co_Q(Q) = wtQ.)
